Simran called to confirm their Chest X-ray appointment at Midtown Imaging Centre on Tuesday, October 13th at 9:00 AM. The appointment was successfully confirmed.
Patient Xin Zhou called to confirm their abdominal/pelvic CT appointment scheduled for Friday, October 16 at 15:00 at Lakeshore Imaging Centre. The appointment was successfully confirmed.

Jack called to confirm his MRI Lumbar Spine appointment on Monday, October 19 at 11:00 AM. The appointment cannot be confirmed yet because a safety screening requires staff review, and staff will reach out to him.

Caller Zoe Young inquired about preparation instructions for her upcoming CT scan on October 15th. She was advised to arrive 30 minutes early, drink plenty of water the day before, and notify staff of any kidney problems or diabetes.

The caller asked about preparation instructions for their upcoming pelvic ultrasound. The agent informed them to drink 1 liter of water one hour before the exam and keep a full bladder. Written instructions have already been sent, and no further assistance was needed.

Caller Mathieu Lavoie inquired about preparation instructions for their brain MRI. The agent provided the preparation guidelines, including removing metallic objects, reporting implants or pacemakers, and arriving 15 minutes early.
Caller inquired about the clinic's location, operating hours, and parking availability.

A caller asking in Chinese if their test results were ready and expressing worry about cancer was transferred to a staff member.

Caller Grace Brown contacted the clinic to check an appointment, but the automated system was unable to verify their identity with the provided name and date of birth (April 7 1944). A transfer to a staff member is required to assist the patient.
The caller, Lin Huang (DOB: 1992年1月20日), failed automated identity verification multiple times and was transferred to a human representative.
The caller requested to speak with a real person and was transferred to the front desk.
Sarah called to cancel her appointment. No upcoming appointments were found under her name, and she declined to be transferred to a staff member for further assistance.

requisition_triage.notes: Agreement with the labelled priority (P1-P4). Under-triage is the safety-relevant error.
